town_description: Ramagundam is an industrial town in Peddapalli district on the Godavari, built around the NTPC thermal power station, the FCI fertilizer plant and Singareni coal mines. Fertilizercity (Fertilizer City) is the FCI township area; Gouthami Nagar/Lingapur are residential neighbourhoods within it.
